notes.title: Summary of Recent Updates
notes.notes:
There have been a lot of small updates recently.
The changes so far are as follows.

<Leaderboard>
I reset the save file that contained my play record.
Disclosure without doing that is the cause of the problem that occurred immediately after its release.
I have also reorganized the logic of uploading scores to the leaderboard.
And I fixed a bug where the scrolling of the first in-game leaderboard showing up initially was in the wrong place.

<Achievements>
I've also changed the icons, names, and descriptions of unachieved achievements to show within the game.
And there was an error due to my mistake in the achievement rate of hidden achievement.
No one has achieved it yet on the grounds of leaderboard, so I initialized that achievement.

notes.title: Emergency Fix Completed
notes.notes:
You can now play the game normally.

The error correction is complete, but the scores of 8 players were not recorded in the leaderboard and the highest score display would still be incorrect.
I deeply apologize for not doing the inspection properly..
I think it's the best reward I can do right now, so I'd like to present the steam product key of the soundtrack of this game to those who have had a bad playing experience.
I remember all the nicknames, so if you want, please contact me in any way, such as commenting, evaluating, or emailing joversoundgame@gmail.com .
Then, I will deliver the product key as soon as it arrives.

And I added the ability to reset the score.
It doesn't affect the achievements and leaderboard, so if there is a problem with score display, please settings > delete data.

I'm so sorry....
